description: Set up the environment so the project builds. Create a minimal amplify_outputs.json stub so TypeScript can compile App.tsx which imports it. Run npm install and verify the build passes.
steps: Create a minimal amplify_outputs.json at the project root with an empty object {} or minimal valid Amplify config shape so the import in src/App.tsx resolves during TypeScript compilation
Run npm install to ensure all dependencies are installed
Run npm run build to verify the project compiles successfully
Run npm run lint to verify no lint errors
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
findings: amplify_outputs.json stub created with minimal {"version": "1"} content. File is gitignored (amplify_outputs* pattern) so it exists only on disk. Build passes with tsc -b and vite build. Lint passes with only 2 pre-existing warnings (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in MeetingControlBar.tsx and VideoMeeting.tsx). tsconfig.app.json uses moduleResolution: bundler which allows JSON imports without explicit resolveJsonModule. No npm install was needed - node_modules already present.
